name: Juara Turtle Project (JTP)
summary: Protects marine biodiversity around Tioman Island through sea turtle conservation, coral restoration, research and community education.
programmes: Sea turtle nest relocation and hatchery
impact: 19,761 eggs relocated and 16,217 hatchlings released in 2025 (82% hatching success)
beneficiaries: Sea turtles and coral reefs of Pulau Tioman; Kampung Juara community; students and volunteers

organisation.founded: 2001 (as a Department of Fisheries hatchery; independent NGO from 2006)
organisation.founders: Started in 2001 by the Department of Fisheries Malaysia; John Amos took over the work in 2006

contact.address: 26800 Kampung Juara, Pulau Tioman, Pahang, Malaysia

live.note: No live or video channel found on website

donationsToday: Online donation form (one-off or recurring, MYR) at donate.juaraturtleproject.com
